backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Question, UserProfile, SubscriptionPlan) and CRUD endpoints for user profiles, questions, subscription plans, and arrays, all gated by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (subscription plans screen, payment method selector, kebab nav menu, etc.) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React/TypeScript frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's light and dark color themes including background, primary, card, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the Vite/React app titled 'AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice' that mounts the React root at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation state across all app screens (home, quiz, results, review, topics, history, admin, subscription, payment), rendering the persistent AppHeader on non-quiz screens and wrapping everything in QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Persistent sticky app header featuring a 3-dot vertical kebab menu button that opens a dropdown navigation drawer with links to all main screens, dismissible by clicking outside.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a large static array of Unani medicine quiz questions with options, correct answers, and explanations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions, and merging backend questions with static local questions for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for storing and retrieving quiz attempt history on the ICP backend, encoding/decoding attempts as arrays of bigints.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: Provides a React Query hook to fetch available subscription plans from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light/dark theme CSS custom properties for a parchment/teal color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel page that allows adding new quiz questions to the backend and listing existing ones, with form validation and feedback messages.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's quiz attempt history with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a list of past results. Includes a clear history button that calls the actor's clearArray method and invalidates the query cache.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Renders the app home screen with a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards for starting a quiz, browsing by topic/year, viewing history, subscription plans, and the admin panel. Merges static and remote questions to compute topic counts and supports random quiz generation.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: Provides a payment method selection UI (UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, wallets) with relevant input fields and a mock payment processing flow. Shows a success confirmation screen after a simulated 2-second delay.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Implements the interactive quiz interface with question navigation, answer selection, progress tracking, and immediate correct/incorrect feedback highlighting. Calls onComplete with all answers and start time when the last question is submitted.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows quiz results including percentage score, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, time taken, and a topic breakdown. Automatically records the attempt via the useRecordAttempt hook on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Displays a post-quiz answer review screen, showing each question with the user's answer and correct answer highlighted, along with explanations and navigation between questions.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders a subscription plans page with monthly and yearly plan options, a toggle to switch between them, and a button to navigate to the payment screen.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Provides a browsable list of questions organized by topic or year, fetched from the backend, with expandable sections and a button to start a shuffled quiz from any group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state including version, feature list, known issues, architectural notes, and image requirements for the AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice app.
